name: rust-repository-entrypoint
description: Repository entrypoint delegating to the standalone Vietnam Basemap Preview workspace

scripts.build:msi: npm --prefix vietnam-basemap-preview run tauri -- build --bundles msi
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix vietnam-basemap-preview run typecheck && npm --prefix vietnam-basemap-preview run test && npm --prefix vietnam-basemap-preview run build
scripts.check:backend: npm --prefix vietnam-basemap-preview run check:platform && npm --prefix vietnam-basemap-preview run check:tauri
